newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-DAY NINE SNIPPETS FROM ROLAND GARROS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-DAY NINE SNIPPETS FROM ROLAND GARROS.

text.p: A brief selection of highlights from the ninth day of the French Open:
Best quote - "Probably not." Steffi Graf, when asked if she thought South African Amanda Coetzer, who had just beaten her in the quarter-finals, could win the tournament.
Stat of the day - 66th. The highest-ranked player in the men's semifinal in the top half of the draw. Brazilan Gustavo Kuerten's opponent, Filip Dewulf, is 122nd.

Only one seed left - Spaniard Sergi Bruguera, the men's 16th and lowest seed, is the only survivor among the men's seeds. Without the last-minute withdrawal of Swede Thomas Enqvist, he would not have been seeded.
